jobs.title: VP, AI/Multitech
jobs.description:
About Us

Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.

What You’ll Do

Establish yourself and your team as unbiased, platform-agnostic technology leaders - the people clients trust to recommend the right solution, not just the one you know best
Champion delivery excellence across AI and multitech engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standard
Build, train, and coach a team that's genuinely fluent across multiple technology platforms, developing depth and breadth rather than single-platform specialists
Make team development a core measure of your own success, growing a bench of multitech-capable practitioners who can flex across ERP, CRM, and AI engagements
Shape your team's structure and capacity in step with the company's regional sales strategy, building capability where the business is headed next - not where it's been
Cultivate senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts
Own the long-term account strategy for key customers, aligning phased delivery plans with Sales' targets and the client's evolving needs
Partner closely with Sales as a true co-owner of account growth - this is one of the most important relationships you'll build in this role
Push AI-driven delivery efficiency forward, keeping performance at or above the firm's defined benchmark.

What You’ll Bring

A genuine technologist at heart - deep, hands-on fluency across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce, with no particular allegiance to either; what matters is credibility across the ecosystem, not expertise in a single tool
Direct, applied experience with AI and automation technologies - generative AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, or AI-driven analytics
Comfort operating across multiple technical domains simultaneously: ERP, CRM, AI/ML tooling, and productivity platforms, with credibility to speak to each without defaulting to a single specialty
A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred; relevant technical certifications (cloud platforms, AI/automation tools, or ERP/CRM-specific credentials) are a strong plus
10+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7-8 of those years hands-on in systems implementation, integration, or automation-driven process re-engineering
A track record of managing distributed, cross-platform delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent projects
Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P&L statements
Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client and regional needs

What Will Set You Apart

A genuine track record of building multitech delivery teams from the ground up, not just managing existing specialists
Demonstrated success leading AI-driven efficiency initiatives with measurable, provable results
Strong executive presence and credible technical authority that holds up in front of C-suite stakeholders and skeptical technical audiences alike
Experience aligning delivery capability with regional sales strategy, building teams ahead of where the business needs them to be
A career built on breadth across platforms rather than depth in just one - genuinely multitech, not multitech-adjacent

What Success Looks Like

AI delivery efficiency consistently meets or exceeds the firm's benchmark, with gains visible in client outcomes, not just internal metrics
Your team is recognized internally and externally as genuinely multitech - capable across platforms, not siloed by specialty
Regional team structure evolves in lockstep with the sales vision, so capability is never the bottleneck to growth
Your partnership with Sales is cited as a model for how Delivery and Sales should work together, with account plans consistently aligned to phased delivery and targets
Clients see you and your team as the unbiased technology authority they can trust, regardless of which platform the conversation starts with

jobs.title: VP Consulting Services, Banking & Financial Services
jobs.description:
**le français à suivre**

Lead and grow one of CGI's most strategic banking relationships

CGI is one of Canada's largest IT and business consulting firms and one of the world's largest independent consulting and technology services organizations.

We are looking for an accomplished executive to join our Financial Services practice in Greater Montréal as Vice-President, Consulting Services
.

This is an opportunity to lead and grow a strategic relationship with a major Canadian financial institution. You will combine executive client leadership, business development, technology and business consulting, delivery oversight, P&L accountability and people leadership
to grow CGI's presence and impact.

Working closely with senior leaders across CIO, Data & AI and technology organizations
, you will bring together CGI's capabilities in Digital Transformation, Data & AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, Managed Services and Business Consulting to address complex business and technology priorities.

Reporting to the Senior Vice-President, Consulting Services, you will operate with significant ownership of your portfolio, leading a high-performing team while being accountable for growth, profitability, client satisfaction and talent development.

What you'll do

Own and grow the executive relationship with a major Canadian banking client, developing trusted relationships across C-suite and senior technology and business leadership.
Develop and execute account growth strategies, identifying, shaping and closing significant consulting and transformation opportunities.
Act as a strategic advisor, bringing banking expertise, technology insight, innovation and thought leadership to client discussions.
Lead strategic pursuits from opportunity identification through solution development, proposal, negotiation and contract closure.
Maintain accountability for revenue, profitability, pipeline, operational performance and sustainable portfolio growth.
Provide executive oversight of complex transformation programs and managed services engagements, ensuring delivery excellence, client satisfaction and effective risk management.
Mobilize expertise from across CGI in areas such as Data & AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation and Business Consulting.
Lead, coach and develop directors and consulting, business development and delivery professionals.
Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability and continuous development.
Contribute to the growth and strategic direction of CGI's Financial Services practice.

What you'll bring

15+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, technology services and/or financial services.
Strong knowledge of the Canadian banking and financial services sector, with credibility among senior technology and business executives.
Demonstrated success in business development, strategic account growth and complex consulting or technology transformation engagements.
Experience managing significant revenue and P&L responsibilities.
Experience leading and developing high-performing consulting and/or delivery organizations.
Strong understanding of current banking transformation priorities, including technology strategy, operating-model transformation, Data & AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity and Digital Transformation.
Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships and lead complex commercial negotiations.
Commercial and entrepreneurial mindset combined with disciplined operational execution.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline. An MBA or advanced degree is an asset.
Executive-level proficiency in French and English, written and spoken.

#Onsite

#LI-AP13

Why CGI?

At CGI, you are more than an employee. You are an owner.

This role gives you the opportunity to operate with an entrepreneurial mindset while benefiting from the scale, expertise and capabilities of a global organization.

You will have the opportunity to shape a strategic banking relationship, influence major business and technology transformations, build and grow your business, develop exceptional talent and collaborate with CGI experts across Canada and globally.

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case.

--

Dirigez et développez une relation bancaire stratégique pour CGI

CGI est l'une des plus importantes entreprises de services-conseils en TI et en gestion au Canada. Nous recherchons un(e) vice-président(e), services-conseils
pour se joindre à notre secteur des Services financiers dans le Grand Montréal.

Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous dirigerez et développerez une relation avec une importante institution financière canadienne. Vous combinerez leadership exécutif, développement des affaires, supervision de la prestation de services, gestion financière et leadership d'équipe
afin d'accroître la présence et l'impact de CGI.

En collaboration avec les hauts dirigeants du client, notamment dans les secteurs des TI, des données et de l'IA, vous mobiliserez les expertises de CGI en transformation numérique, données et IA, infonuagique, cybersécurité, services en mode délégué et conseil en gestion.
Relevant du vice-président principal, services-conseils, vous serez responsable de la croissance, de la rentabilité, de la satisfaction client et du développement des talents de votre portefeuille.

Vos responsabilités

Développer des relations de confiance avec la haute direction et les leaders technologiques et d'affaires du client.
Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de croissance et identifier, structurer et conclure d'importantes occasions d'affaires.
Agir comme conseiller(ère) stratégique en apportant expertise sectorielle, innovation et perspectives technologiques.
Diriger les démarches commerciales, de l'identification des occasions jusqu'à la négociation et la conclusion des ententes.
Assurer la responsabilité des revenus, de la rentabilité, du pipeline et de la performance opérationnelle du portefeuille.
Superviser des programmes de transformation complexes et assurer l'excellence de la prestation, la satisfaction client et la gestion des risques.
Mobiliser les expertises de CGI en données et IA, infonuagique, cybersécurité, transformation numérique et conseil en gestion.
Diriger, accompagner et développer une équipe performante de leaders et de professionnels.
Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration et de développement continu.
Contribuer à la croissance et à l'orientation stratégique du secteur des Services financiers de CGI.

Profil recherché

Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en leadership dans les services-conseils, les services technologiques et/ou les services financiers.
Solide connaissance du secteur bancaire et financier canadien et crédibilité auprès de hauts dirigeants.
Expérience démontrée en développement des affaires, croissance de comptes stratégiques et transformation technologique
.
Expérience dans la gestion de revenus, de la rentabilité et de responsabilités financières importantes.
Expérience en direction et développement d'équipes performantes.
Bonne compréhension des priorités de transformation bancaire : stratégie technologique, données et IA, infonuagique, cybersécurité et transformation numérique.
Forte présence exécutive et capacité à influencer, à bâtir des relations de confiance et à mener des négociations complexes.
Esprit entrepreneurial, sens des affaires et rigueur opérationnelle.
Diplôme universitaire dans un domaine pertinent. MBA ou diplôme de deuxième cycle, un atout.
Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit.

Pourquoi CGI?

Chez CGI, vous êtes plus qu'un(e) employé(e) : vous êtes propriétaire
.

Vous aurez l'occasion de développer une relation bancaire stratégique, d'influencer d'importantes transformations d'affaires et technologiques, de faire croître vos activités et vos équipes et de collaborer avec les experts de CGI au Canada et ailleurs dans le monde.

CGI offre une estimation raisonnable de la fourchette salariale pour ce poste. Le calcul de cette fourchette dépend de divers facteurs, notamment le niveau de compétence, le marché géographique, l'expérience, la formation ainsi que les licences et certifications professionnelles. Les décisions en matière de rémunération dépendent des particularités de chaque cas.

jobs.title: Global Treasury and Finance Audit, AVP
jobs.description:
Corporate Audit is looking for an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead and execute complex audits and validation work across Global Treasury. The role will primarily cover liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, investment portfolio, governance, and related regulatory reporting.

The successful candidate will combine strong audit execution and leadership skills with practical knowledge of Treasury risk management. The individual will lead assigned audit teams through planning, testing, issue development, and reporting. They will also review work for quality and evidentiary support and communicate conclusions to senior management.

The role is for an experienced auditor who must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, communicate clearly, and already possess strong auditing capabilities.

Why this role is important to us

The audit team plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, the firm, relies on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability; regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Global Treasury Audit, AVP you will

Lead complex audits across Global Treasury, from planning, through testing, issue development, and final reporting.
Direct audit teams assigned to individual engagements, establish clear expectations, monitor delivery, review workpapers, and coach team members throughout the engagement.
Plan and perform controls testing, including walkthroughs, sample selection, inspection of evidence, reperformance and evaluation of operating effectiveness.
Evaluate Treasury processes against applicable regulatory requirements, supervisory guidance, internal policies, and established risk limits.
Apply professional skepticism to assess the quality, completeness and reliability of evidence, and challenge unsupported or inconsistent explanations.
Use data analytics to support testing, identify anomalies and enable continuous monitoring where appropriate.
Communicate testing status, emerging concerns, scope changes and delivery risks promptly to audit management, together with fact-based analysis and proposed solutions.
Build constructive relationships across the lines of defense while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.
Maintain current knowledge of Global Treasury risks, regulatory expectations and industry practices, particularly in liquidity risk, asset-liability management and interest rate risk.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Practical knowledge of Treasury risk management, with experience in liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, asset and liability management, or a related discipline.
Strong analytical and professional judgment, including the ability to identify the risks that matter and develop well-supported conclusions.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, meet commitments and escalate obstacles early in a fast-paced environment.
Clear, factual and concise written and verbal communication, including communication with senior management and regulators.
Ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations relevant to Treasury and liquidity requirements and supervisory guidance.
Collaborative approach and ability to provide clear direction and review feedback to audit team members.

Education And Required Qualifications

The following are required:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management or a related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, Global Treasury, public accounting, or another first- or second-line risk management role.
Experience leading significant workstreams and audit engagements.
Advanced degree or certification, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or its equivalent preferred.

Salary Range

$80,000 - $140,000 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home .

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
SETUP
: Mostly remote, only required 1-2 times/month in office. Located in North York, ON

CONTRACT
: 18 months

About the Opportunity

Financial Reporting & Consolidations:
Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements and management reporting.
Oversee the consolidation of multiple legal entities/business units, including intercompany balances, eliminations, foreign currency translation, and consolidation adjustments.
Ensure financial reporting is accurate, complete, appropriately supported, and delivered within established reporting timelines.
Maintain and enhance consolidation processes, reporting packages, and financial controls.
Partner with business units and finance teams to resolve consolidation and reporting issues.

US GAAP & IFRS:
Serve as a key technical accounting resource for matters involving US GAAP and IFRS.
Research and assess complex accounting issues and provide recommendations regarding appropriate accounting treatment.
Monitor new and emerging accounting standards and assess their impact on the organization.
Lead the implementation of new accounting standards and changes to existing reporting requirements.
Prepare and review technical accounting memos, position papers, and supporting documentation.
Support accounting matters involving areas such as revenue recognition, leases, business combinations, foreign currency, impairment, and other complex transactions, as applicable.

Controls, Audit & Compliance:
Maintain a strong financial control environment across the reporting and consolidation processes.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support quarterly and annual audit requirements.
Ensure appropriate documentation and supporting schedules are maintained for significant accounting judgments, estimates, and transactions.
Identify reporting and control risks and implement process improvements to strengthen financial governance.
Leadership & Business Partnership:
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4–5 finance and accounting professionals, establishing clear responsibilities and development priorities.
Provide technical guidance and oversight to the team while promoting accountability and high-quality execution.
Partner closely with FP&A, Corporate Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and other finance functions to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reporting.
Work with senior leadership to communicate financial reporting matters, accounting implications, and significant issues.
Support acquisitions, integrations, restructuring activities, and other strategic initiatives from an accounting and reporting perspective.

Process Improvement:
Drive improvements to the financial close, consolidation, and reporting processes with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, standardization, and scalability.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reconciliation activities.
Strengthen reporting processes, systems, and controls as the organization grows and reporting requirements evolve.

About You

CPA designation.
10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including significant experience in a leadership capacity.
Strong technical knowledge and practical application of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
Significant experience with multi-entity consolidations, including intercompany eliminations and foreign currency considerations.
Experience leading and developing accounting or financial reporting teams.

307950.

You must currently reside within the Greater Toronto area and be permitted to work in Canada to be considered for this opportunity.
